source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Enroll_DB_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS Enroll_DB_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Enroll_DB_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS Enroll_DB_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_499_Enroll' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_499_STAGING_ENROLL_Stage_NE_Unborn_Members2276__sink_TableName;

SELECT DISTINCT sup.[MedicaidID] 	  ,sup.[SSN] 	  ,[MomFName] = COALESCE(NULLIF(sup.[MomFName],''),unborn.[MomFName],'') 	  ,[MomMInt] = COALESCE(NULLIF(sup.[MomMInt],''),unborn.[MomMInt],'') 	  ,[MomLName] = COALESCE(NULLIF(sup.[MomLName],''),unborn.[MomLName],'') 	  ,sup.[PrimEmail] 	  ,unborn.[HOHFName]       ,unborn.[HOHMInit]       ,unborn.[HOHLName] 	  ,unborn.[ExpDeliveryDt] 	  ,UnbornMedicaidID = unborn.[MedicaidID] 	  ,unborn.[MailAddr1] 	  ,unborn.MailCity 	  ,unborn.MailState 	  ,unborn.MailZip      FROM [Enroll].[dbo].[Nebraska_Supplemental] sup INNER JOIN [Enroll].[dbo].[Nebraska_Unborn] unborn 	ON sup.MedicaidID = unborn.Assoc_MedicaidID
